our_interpretation: Further souring means an observable deterioration in AI infrastructure credit conditions after October 20, 2026.
Paying interest means the annual borrowing cost on new financing, rather than the secondary-market yield on previously issued fixed-coupon bonds.
Three years describes the approximate lead time to the financed data centers becoming operational. It does not clearly impose a deadline for obtaining financing.
The customer description is part of the predicted project characteristics, not a separate antecedent.
A sector-wide prediction requires representative financing evidence rather than one unusually risky borrower.
criteria.support_condition: Following further credit deterioration, representative new financings carry annual interest costs of 12%–15% for data centers approximately three years from operation whose committed demand comes overwhelmingly from Anthropic and OpenAI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable financing after the trigger systematically falls outside the stated range, or representative projects materially fail the stated construction timing or customer-concentration description.
